description: Rothco’s USA Flag Low Profile Cap is the perfect way to display your patriotic pride while enjoying a comfortable and durable hat. This cap features a finely embroidered red, white, and blue American flag on the front panel, paired with “USA” text embroidered on the left side for added flair. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap is lightweight, breathable, and soft to the touch. The internal sweatband keeps you dry and comfortable by preventing sweat from running into your eyes, while the top ventilation holes allow heat to escape, keeping your head cool on hot days. The cap’s front panel is reinforced with buckram to provide structure and maintain the cap's shape over time. With its adjustable hook & loop strap closure, this cap ensures a perfect fit for most head sizes. Whether you're out for a casual day or attending an event, Rothco’s USA Flag Low Profile Cap is a must-have accessory to show off your patriotic spirit. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
